bronze_male.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Workout Tracker sport mastery avatar. Generate exactly ONE fictional male Cricket athlete for the Bronze tier. Polished premium semi-realistic stylised 3D game-skin illustration, credible for ages 10 through adult; crisp face, natural athletic proportions, well-defined hands and believable equipment. Original character, not a real athlete or celebrity. Character identity: medium olive skin, short dark brown hair, brown eyes. Visibly junior athlete, approximately 12–14, natural youthful face and proportions, modest practical kit; no adult musculature or jewellery. Collection palette: ivory junior whites; navy and gold team accents; formal navy at Unreal. This tier's outfit below determines the current colours. Outfit: Basic junior ivory cricket whites, plain pads and simple gloves. Equipment: Flat-faced willow cricket bat, red leather cricket ball when needed, correctly shaped batting pads/gloves. Cricket helmet may rest on the ground; keep the face visible. Never a baseball bat. Award: None. Pose: Relaxed junior three-quarter introduction facing left, both hands lightly resting on a safely grounded bat handle; single red ball beside boots. No award. Tier silhouette direction: Relaxed introductory three-quarter view; natural asymmetrical weight distribution and curious expression. Establish the junior identity without a stiff catalogue stance. Square portrait. Entire head, hands, equipment and both feet visible, centred with 6–8% clear transparent margins. Athlete occupies roughly 80–88% of canvas height; trophies fit naturally inside the frame. Keep face and torso unobstructed. Match the rendering finish and proportions of the supplied style reference, but follow this tier's kit and award brief. Keep the corresponding male and female tier equal in prestige, award scale, kit quality and visual presence. Create a real transparent background with clean alpha edges. No words, lettering, numbers, brand or team logos, watermark, border, background scene, extra people, unrelated weapons, fantasy armour, wings, magic, neon aura or trophy clutter. Bronze has no award. Do not invent extra medals or accessories. No copied official trophy inscriptions. Preserve recognisable eye shape, skin tone and hair character, while visibly ageing the same fictional person. Do not preserve the junior face proportions in adult tiers. Mature facial structure, natural eye-to-face proportions, a developed nose/jaw and less rounded cheeks must make Platinum onward unmistakably adult in BOTH appearances; do not rely on muscles, makeup, a beard, suit or trophies to signal age. Styling stays polished and semi-realistic, with no oversized doll eyes or baby-faced adult. Pose references supply equipment/kit only: do not duplicate their stance, hand placement, body angle or expression across tiers. The sport is this individual's story, not a demographic stereotype or a restriction that this person can only play one sport.

Sport-specific constraints: Use existing Cricket Bronze and Unreal as style references, not as permission to copy real logos or trophy inscriptions. Male and female final honours can have equally prestigious original silhouettes inspired by the ICC men’s and women’s overall cricketer-of-the-year awards. This is cricket mastery, not a batting-only qualification.
Input1 existing Cricket style reference only, not age/pose lock; input2 Football Bronze premium paired collection finish. Cricket child age13 with medium olive skin, short dark brown hair and brown eyes, a distinct fictional character. Natural age-appropriate proportions not chibi. BOTH hands in correctly shaped simple cricket gloves resting on grounded willow bat handle, ivory whites and plain pads. One red cricket ball beside boots. No helmet required, no awards. 6–8% clear alpha margin, entire equipment and both boots inside square.
